# Stagepulse

> Stagepulse is a Hatay / Antakya based live-event audio and technical production company led by FOH engineer İbrahim Kavasoğlu.

## Canonical identity
- Name: Stagepulse
- Alternate name: Stagepulse FOH Engineer
- Website: https://stagepulse.com.tr/
- Primary region: Hatay / Antakya, Türkiye
- Lead person: İbrahim Kavasoğlu
- Role: FOH Engineer
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/stagepulse.hatay

## Core services
- Ses sistemi kiralama
- FOH mühendisliği ve canlı miks
- Stage Plot ve sahne planlama
- SPL hesaplama
- 3D sahne çizimi
- Teknik rider hazırlama
- Işık ve truss kiralama
- Etkinlik teknik prodüksiyonu
